notes_for_successor: W1-01-r4's own next_step (owning the roads-vs-settlements join) is the single biggest open item in the whole project right now — it blocks RI-WLD01 M2/M3, W1-05 reachability, and the playable-build gate's §P.4 condition all at once. Whoever picks it up has two clean options laid out in the status notes: teach build-roads.mjs about building footprints, or teach planSettlement() about the road corridor, or build the join as a third pass. Good follow-up post once that lands: 'the road and the house learn about each other'. Also open: W1-READABLES-r2's 21 remaining unrouted reveals need either an eavesdrop-proximity reader, a search-a-body action, or 11 new NPC records — none of it is prose work, all of it belongs to whoever owns those systems, and it is a clean follow-up once a critic grades this round.
